extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Pinellas County has a $35 monthly premium, a $95 drug deductible and a $4300 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer was advised of the limited scope of plans offered and the agent provided a detailed comparison of plans.
composition.coaching_note: Owen did a great job following all compliance rules. However, he could improve by more clearly explaining the scope of plans offered in the disclaimer. This will help ensure the customer fully understands the limitations.
